mapper.sql: o.id, o.order_no, o.student_name, o.phone, o.product_id, p.product_name, p.study_mode as product_study_mode, o.class_id, c.class_term, o.student_code, o.product_amount, o.discount_amount, o.receivable_amount, o.paid_amount, o.order_status, o.created_at, o.updated_at, s.id as student_id, as fulfillment_status
case when o.order_status = 'CLOSED' then 'CLOSED' when o.order_status != 'PAID' then 'PENDING_PAYMENT' when s.id is not null then 'ENROLLED' else 'PENDING_ENROLLMENT' end
mapper.select: select id from sale_order where id = #{id} for update
select id from sale_order where order_no = #{orderNo} for update
mapper.update: update sale_order set student_name = #{studentName}, phone = #{phone}, product_id = #{productId}, class_id = #{classId}, student_code = #{studentCode}, product_amount = #{productAmount}, discount_amount = #{discountAmount}, receivable_amount = #{receivableAmount}, paid_amount = #{paidAmount}, order_status = #{orderStatus}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select from sale_order o left join sale_product p on p.id = o.product_id left join edu_class c on c.id = o.class_id left join edu_student s on s.student_code = o.student_code and s.product_id = o.product_id and s.phone = o.phone and (p.study_mode = 'ONLINE' or s.class_id = o.class_id) where o.id = #{id}
